content.title: Boston Red Sox vs Houston Astros Live Stream: How to Watch MLB (March 30)
content.text: The Astros will host the Red Sox on Monday night as the teams kick off a three-game series in Houston. The Boston Red Sox will travel to Houston on Monday to take on the Astros in the first game of a three-game series at Daikin Park. The Red Sox come into their second road test with a record of 1-2 after opening weekend, beating the Reds in the season opener before dropping the next two games in the series. The Astros went 2-2 to open the 2026 season, falling to the Los Angeles Angels in the first two games of their series before winning the final two. While the season is still young, the teams will both look to tack on more wins early this week to gain some momentum before going into their respective weekend series. How to Watch Boston Red Sox vs Houston Astros in MLB Today: Game Date: Monday, March 30, 2026 Game Time: 8:10 p.m. ET TV: NESN, MLB.TV – Houston Astros Location: Daikin Park Live stream the Boston Red Sox vs Houston Astros game on Fubo: Start watching now! The Red Sox closed out their series with the Reds on Sunday, falling in a narrow 3-2 defeat. Greg Weissert took the loss on the mound after giving up two earned runs in 0.2 innings of work. Connelly Early got the start for Boston and played well, throwing for 5.1 innings and striking out six batters. Wilyer Abreu brought in the only two runs for the Red Sox with a two-run homer to center field in the fourth, marking his second home run of the season. After opening 2026 at 0-2, the Astros fought their way back in their series to improve to .500. In Sunday’s finale with the Angels, Isaac Paredes led at the plate, going 2-for-5 with two RBI, hitting a two-run double in the bottom of the eighth, his third double of the 2026 season already. Also hitting doubles were Jose Altuve and Christian Walker to help the Astros earn a 9-7 win which was credited to AJ Blubaugh who threw for two innings in which he gave up zero hits and struck out two batters. Bryan King earned the save with two strikeouts to close out the game. The Red Sox will look to left-handed pitcher Ranger Suarez, the former Philadelphia Phillies ace, with the start on Monday night while the Astros will put the ball in right-handed pitcher Lance McCullers Jr. Both pitchers will hope to bring their best in their first starts of 2026 to remain firmly in the rotation.
